name: hud_cmd_binding_destroy_range
description: HudCmdBinding::DestroyRange frees each binding display string, deletes each binding object, clears the destination slots, and returns the advanced destination pointer.
known_limits: VC byte verification does not currently match: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs failed for 0x40be00 with 50 unmasked mismatches after masking 8 relocation bytes and trimming 7 NOPs.
functional_evidence: Native smoke verifies non-null entries are deleted, null entries are tolerated, destination slots are cleared, and the returned destination pointer advances by the destroyed range length.

Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40be00 shows first/last fastcall range iteration, CRT free on displayText, operator delete on each non-null entry, destination slot clearing, and return of the advanced destination pointer.
